name: What transportation costs should I budget for in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: What transportation costs should I budget for in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: Transportation costs in South Florida typically include car payments, insurance, fuel, and potential toll road fees. Public transportation options vary by county, with Miami-Dade offering Metrorail and Metromover, and all counties having bus services. Car insurance rates can be higher in South Florida than in other parts of the country due to population density and traffic. When choosing a location, consider its proximity to your workplace and amenities to potentially reduce commuting costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Budget for car payments, insurance, fuel, and tolls in South Florida. Car insurance rates can be higher, and public transport varies by county.
